name: ola-desktop
description: Ola Chat desktop (Electron wrapper cho web/)
author: Ola Chat

scripts.dev:electron-only: pnpm build:main && cross-env OLA_DESKTOP_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
scripts.smoke: pnpm build:main && cross-env OLA_DESKTOP_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
scripts.dist: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:main && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:main && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:main && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:main && electron-builder --linux --publish never
